svg.title: Forest: chances and goals
svg.desc: Nottingham Forest's first six league matches: five goals compared with 10.3 expected goals. Premier League, first six matches of 2026/27. Figures reported on 16 October. xG estimates chance quality; it is not a forecast for the Arsenal match.
